taxa.concept_boundary: POWO/WCVP accepts the species and two subspecies. Earlier rank usage as var. majus and combinations in Desmazeria/Sclerochloa must map to the accepted subsp. majus concept without creating another species. Authors matter for illegitimate later homonyms Festuca rigida (L.) Raspail and Diplachne rigida (L.) Chapm. Do not automatically assign a subspecies to the existing species-level photograph or observation.
taxa.duplicate_guardrail: Preserve one existing Catapodium rigidum species learner; do not create species cards for synonyms or infraspecific aliases. No unsupported subspecies photo determination.
